findings.conclusion: Ordinary check-in sets checkinDone and ending page before opening the current game; pending save can legally resume only while prologue remains current. Real exported/imported save and separate normal entry were exercised in a fresh receipt profile.

Six physical text contacts map to three semantic stages. Coordinate names are unordered; sentence fragments are ordered. Failure preserves collected set and stage, clears unsafe cards and restarts only missing targets. Reread and failure stop simulation; background words leaving unblocked are safe. moved_distance affects demonstration/failure classification only, not valid target capture.

Only semantic completion opens lock, held input must reach 1400ms, then four dialogue intervals, 950ms burst and 700ms whiteout precede once-only result. Web controller validates unchanged three-fields proof; native additionally validates dialogueCount and whiteoutCompleted. Scene audio cues only request presentation; neither sound completion nor runtime inspection snapshot commits progress.

Fresh ending runtime begins zero progress. No word/card progress save fields were added. Invalid incomplete/failed proof is rejected; already completed chapter phase cannot regress via old C1 result. Main captures active-game identity and ignores stale activity callbacks. This is an internal controller contract, not tamper-proof attestation against arbitrary code execution.
